# US Estate Extension

US-specific estate planning: federal and state estate tax, community/separate property regimes, elective share, homestead exemptions, per stirpes variants, no-contest clauses, pretermitted heir statutes, RUFADAA, Louisiana forced heirship, probate variation, trust features, SECURE Act retirement rules, ancillary probate, advance directives.

Source: [`v3/extensions/us-estate/us-estate.json`](../../../../v3/extensions/us-estate/us-estate.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/extensions/us-estate/us-estate.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `string` | yes | US state in ISO 3166-2 format (e.g. US-CA, US-NY) — determines which state succession, property regime, and tax laws apply |
| `propertyRegime` | `string` — one of `community_property`, `community_property_with_survivorship`, `separate_property`, `quasi_community` | | |
| `electiveShareDetails` | `object` | | |
| `homesteadExemptions` | array of `object` | | |
| `perStirpesVariant` | `string` — one of `strict_per_stirpes`, `modern_per_stirpes`, `per_capita_at_each_generation` | | |
| `noContestEnforceable` | `boolean` | | |
| `pretermittedHeirStatute` | `string` | | |
| `rufadaaAdopted` | `boolean` | | |
| `louisianaForcedHeirship` | `object` | | |
| `notes` | `string` | | |
| `federalEstateTax` | `object` | | Federal estate tax under IRC Title 26 — exemption, portability, GSTT |
| `stateEstateTax` | `object` | | State-level estate and inheritance tax — 12 states + DC have estate tax, 6 states have inheritance tax |
| `probateVariation` | `object` | | State probate process variation — UPC adoption, thresholds, administration types |
| `trustFeatures` | `object` | | US-specific trust qualifiers — does not duplicate core trust.json, captures state-level features |
| `retirementAccountRules` | `object` | | SECURE Act retirement account distribution rules — 10-year rule, eligible designated beneficiaries |
| `intestacyRules` | `object` | | State-specific intestacy variation — surviving spouse share, property rules |
| `ancillaryProbate` | array of `object` | | Ancillary probate proceedings when the decedent owns property in multiple states |
| `advanceDirectives` | `object` | | US-specific advance directive and POA features — UHCDA, UPOAA, HIPAA |
| `communityPropertyDetails` | `object` | | Elaborates the propertyRegime enum — specifics for community property states |
| `intestacyDepth` | `object` | | How deeply the state's intestacy rules extend into the kinship tree |
| `collateralHeirRules` | `object` | | Rules governing collateral heirs (uncles/aunts, cousins) in this state's intestacy scheme |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
